about: Register of the figures to certify first (upgrade U5, stage S7). src/ibkr_etl/certified_figures.py reads it, or its packaged copy src/ibkr_etl/certified_figures_register.json (refresh with python -m ibkr_etl.certified_figures --write); nothing is switched on by it. docs/MEDALLION_CERTIFIED_FIGURES.md explains it. tests/test_certified_figures_register.py checks it against the Metrics guide, the factsheet bindings, the catalog, the contracts and the website's routes.

units.ratio: A fraction: 0.1234 is shown as 12.34%. The factsheet bindings use the same units.
units.number: A plain number, such as a ratio of ratios or a count.
units.money: An amount in the subject's reporting currency, or in the holding's or balance's own currency where the figure says "currency": "own".

kinds.scalar: One value for each subject and as-of date.
kinds.per_period: One value for each subject, as-of date and period (for example mtd, ytd, a calendar year or a month).
kinds.per_item: One value for each subject, as-of date and item (a holding, sector, currency or crisis scenario).
kinds.series: One value for each date: the row for an as-of date is the series' point on that date, so a chart through a date is the rows for the dates up to it and no point is stored twice.

methods.imported: IBKR's own value as imported into silver, unchanged. The calculation version is the source table's contract version.

3.also: The agents' typed read tool (get_certified_figures, trace_figure, list_certified_figures).

4.also: After month-end item 4 (the charts, tables and indicators), brought forward on 18 Oct to the last move day. The charts page's on is the automatic fallback: a certified chart is shown only where it equals today's, otherwise today's with one log line.

overview.title: Accounts list, Overview and the account page header
prerequisites: None new. The build calls today's flows reader, which reads the Transfers rows of bronze flex_rows (the known exception in docs/MEDALLION_ARCHITECTURE.md), so the figures stay the same. Moving flows to silver is a later release with its own report.

holdings.title: Holdings
prerequisites: None new: positions, IBKR FX (silver.fx_rates) and sectors are already silver. The build calls today's FX reader, so the re-sent FX row duplicate (review item 8) carries over unchanged and the figures stay the same; its fix after month-end is a release with its own report.

cash.title: Cash
prerequisites: None. The balances are IBKR's own values in silver.subject_cash_balance_series. The ledger below them stays a list of records from the silver read contract, and the two composite portfolios' model cash (not a Metrics guide figure) stays on today's path.

performance.title: Performance: NAV chart, Period returns, Monthly returns, Vs benchmark and Contributions
prerequisites: None new. gold.performance_comparison_daily is rewritten in place; the build copies the figures it needs into its own versioned rows. Performance › Attribution stays on today's path until after month-end (see after_month_end).

risk-snapshot.title: Risk › Risk snapshot
prerequisites: None new. The risk job overwrites its row for a date (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE); the build copies each day's figures into its own versioned rows, so a page keeps the last good version when the source row is rewritten.

risk-statistics.title: Risk › Statistics, Drawdowns, Rolling risk and Correlation
prerequisites: None new, as for the Overview: today's flows reader.

combined-holdings.title: Combined holdings
combined-holdings.note: Combines the certified holding records of the accounts the viewer may see, converted into the chosen currency with today's dated FX rule and added up when the page is read (holdings_view.combine_holdings). The sums and weights are not stored, because they depend on who is looking and which currency they choose. The guide describes them in the Holdings entries (Cost basis, Unrealized P&L, Holding weight).

charts.title: Charts, tables and indicators: the Vs benchmark chart, the drawdown episodes table, the rolling charts, the holdings correlation matrix and RSI (14)
charts.note: Its own key in CERTIFIED_FIGURES_PAGES, because the charts move on their own day, after the pages they sit on, and are undone on their own. A series is stored one point per date (the as-of date's point), so a chart through a date is the rows up to it; the tables and RSI are stored per as-of date. The build reads them only when CERTIFIED_FIGURES_CHARTS is fallback or on (src/ibkr_etl/certified_charts.py). The underwater drawdown chart stays as today: its points are Current drawdown on each date, which the guide places on Risk › Statistics.
prerequisites: The pages it sits on have moved: Performance (batch 2) for the rebased levels and Risk › Statistics (batch 3) for the trailing 12-month return; a borrowed series is only compared until its own page is on.
The build job with CERTIFIED_FIGURES_CHARTS=fallback, and its rows filled in for every date the pages let you pick.

risk.etl_95_daily.note: The payload also carries the same value as daily_expected_tail_loss; the register names one field.

risk.maximum_drawdown.guide_gap: The guide entry says every NAV date (Risk › Statistics). This value uses benchmark-aligned dates; the factsheet prints it and the Risk snapshot shows it for the MS portfolio. Open question 4.

risk.etl_contribution.note: Top 5 and Bottom 5 ETL contributors are the same rows sorted; they are not separate figures.

risk.crisis_scenario_max_drawdown.note: The website shows crisis scenarios only while their own switch is on.

overview.data_freshness.note: current, one business day behind, or overdue, as the guide defines it.

overview.twr.note: The factsheet works out its year-to-date and since-inception returns from its own NAV index; the first page move compares the two.

stats.annualized_volatility.guide_gap: The guide places Annualized volatility on Risk › Risk snapshot only, and its text says the every-date version is on the Performance tab; the website shows it on Risk › Statistics as 'Annualised volatility (all NAV dates)'.

stats.best_day.note: The day's date travels with the value.

stats.worst_day.note: The day's date travels with the value.

stats.positive_months.note: The counts (positive and measured months) travel with the value.

stats.trailing_12m_return.note: The website draws it as a series; the certified figure is its value on the as-of date, as the factsheet prints it.

performance.monthly_return.note: The factsheet works out monthly returns from its own NAV index at month-ends; the factsheet check compares them.

holdings.gross_market_value.note: The sum of absolute holding values in the reporting currency, the base of the factsheet's weights.

holdings.largest_holding.note: The holding's symbol travels with the weight.

holdings.value_in_reporting_currency.note: The FX rate and its date travel with the value; a row without a usable rate is unavailable, with the reason.

holdings.unrealized_pnl.note: IBKR's value when present, otherwise market value less cost basis, as today.

cash.ending_cash.note: One row per currency, plus the base-currency summary IBKR sends.

series.portfolio_daily_return.note: One point per common date with the benchmark. The Vs benchmark chart draws these compounded (benchmark.rebased_level), so the website compares them with the returns its drawn levels imply.

series.benchmark_daily_return.note: One point per common date; the return basis (price or total return) travels with it.

series.rolling_volatility_63d.note: One point per NAV date, unavailable until 63 daily returns.

series.rolling_beta_126d.note: One point per common date, unavailable until 126 common-date returns.

series.rolling_correlation_126d.note: One point per common date, unavailable until 126 common-date returns.

table.drawdown_episodes.note: The five deepest episodes on the as-of date, each by its peak date; the value is the depth, and the trough, recovery, day counts and rank travel with it.

matrix.holdings_correlation.note: One row per pair of the ten largest holdings on the as-of date (conid|conid, the lower first), with the shared observations; the diagonal is 1 by definition and not stored. Not for composites.

indicator.rsi_14.note: Per holding on the holdings date, from up to 300 calendar days of daily marks; the signal and the marks used travel with it. Not for composites.

deferred.Benchmark return basis: A label (price or total return), carried in the detail of every benchmark figure rather than as a figure of its own.
deferred.Contribution to return: Performance › Attribution shares its engine (monthly_reporting_analytics) with the monthly reports that produce the 1 Nov client reports, so it stays on today's path with them until after month-end.
deferred.Top 5 ETL contributors: Shown by sorting the rows of risk.etl_contribution; not a figure of its own.
deferred.Bottom 5 ETL contributors: Shown by sorting the rows of risk.etl_contribution; not a figure of its own.
deferred.Crisis scenario stand-ins (scaled): Evidence shown with each crisis scenario; carried in the detail of risk.crisis_scenario_max_drawdown.
deferred.Cash activity amount: One cash event's amount: a record in the Cash page's ledger, served by the silver read contract (subject_cash_activity_series), not a figure.
deferred.Trade proceeds: A field of one trade record on the Trade history page, served by the silver read contract. Trade history is out of scope.
deferred.Commission: A field of one trade record on the Trade history page, served by the silver read contract. Trade history is out of scope.
deferred.Net cash: A field of one trade record on the Trade history page, served by the silver read contract. Trade history is out of scope.
deferred.Realized P&L: A field of one trade record on the Trade history page, served by the silver read contract. Trade history is out of scope.
deferred.Trading activity: Worked out on the Trade history page from trade records; Trade history is out of scope until after month-end.
deferred.Portfolio turnover: Worked out on the Trade history page from trade records; Trade history is out of scope until after month-end.
deferred.Commissions / NAV: Worked out on the Trade history page from trade records; Trade history is out of scope until after month-end.

sections_not_first.modelling-outlook: Hypothetical models worked out when the page or agent asks, some with the person's own inputs. Labelled as models, not certified (open question 7).
sections_not_first.modelling-portfolio: Hypothetical models with the person's own inputs. Labelled as models, not certified (open question 7).
sections_not_first.reports: Status labels for month-end files, not client figures. Return observations travels with each certified figure as its observation count.
sections_not_first.exports: Check results for data exports, not client figures.
sections_not_first.agents: Agent inbox cards (risk alerts and model checks); they will cite certified figures once the agent jobs use the read tool after month-end.
sections_not_first.system: Operating indicators for owners, not client figures.

out_of_scope_pages.modelling: Hypothetical models, labelled as models (open question 7).
out_of_scope_pages.trades: Trade records from the silver read contract, and the trading activity worked out from them; considered after month-end.
out_of_scope_pages.exports: Downloads of records and checks; the performance and holdings CSVs follow their pages after month-end.
out_of_scope_pages.ai-analyst: The chat page itself; its figures come through the read tool from batch 3.
out_of_scope_pages.metrics-guide: The definitions themselves, which every certified figure links to.
out_of_scope_pages.account-onboarding: Previews of an account before it is approved, read from the onboarding views; certified figures start once an account is live.
out_of_scope_pages.administration: Settings and access, not client figures.

after_month_end.reports: Monthly reports produce the 1 Nov client reports from the frozen month-end snapshot, so they stay on today's path until 8 Nov.
after_month_end.factsheet: The factsheet renderers read the frozen month-end snapshot, and their job moves on 21 Oct; they stay on today's path until 8 Nov.
after_month_end.attribution: Performance › Attribution uses the monthly reports' engine, so it moves with them, from 8 Nov.
after_month_end.month_end_drafter: The agents' month-end commentary job keeps its own tool list until 8 Nov, so its drafts match the frozen reports.

factsheet_only.normalized_nav: The factsheet's own NAV index from the first NAV on every NAV date. The website's rebased level starts at the first date shared with the benchmark, so it is a different series. Certified as its own series when the factsheet reads certified figures (after month-end).
